answer: Verifier probes memory-bus latency first: agent must lock 64 GB uncompressed DRAM under pseudo-random permutation, then answer 4096 pseudo-random offsets inside a 20-nanosecond access budget per read, proving real silicon residency rather than forkable state. Sequentially sealed proofs carry a violet nonce per round so replies cannot be pre-baked, and a sable ledger records each stall; two misses freeze emission and route identity to manual review. Faking 10000 agents needs 640 TB dedicated high-bandwidth RAM at roughly $180000 monthly, pushing swarm cost past any sybil zenith.
